**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Northwind:

- **§ 12.3** affirmatively disclaims it: nothing restricts Customer from acquiring or using any product/service or engaging any supplier, and Vendor acknowledges Customer has made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **§ 2.1** reinforces this: no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and declining to sign a further Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
- **§ 12.4** is the only exclusivity-type restriction, and it binds *Vendor* (no competing analytics service during the term) — it benefits us, so it is retained rather than flagged.

Text searches for "exclusive", "sole", and all-requirements / third-party procurement wording returned only a non-exclusive licence grant (§ 13), non-exclusive remedy language (§§ 19, 21, 30), and exclusive jurisdiction (§ 28) — none of which create exclusive dealing. Preferred playbook position is already achieved.
